_comment: The four difficulty ladders, from docs/authored content/difficulty.md. build.mjs INLINES this as const DIFFICULTY - never fetched at runtime (CSP, file:// CORS). Edit here, then run: node build.mjs
_units: ALL MONEY IS INTEGER CENTS. Times are seconds. Rates are cents per second and may be fractional: difficulty.md writes them as '$1.00 / 3 seconds', which is 100/3 = 33.33 cents/s. start = starting clock; extend = seconds one extension adds; maxExt = extensions allowed per shift; target = deliveries or tickets that clear the level, and build.mjs rejects it unless it is exactly 3 x maxExt (GDD II.D.3). tipStart/tipFloor/tipDecay are the delivery tip: it starts at tipStart and falls at tipDecay, holding at tipFloor (owner ruling 5 keeps the $2.00 floor). fines are flat charges; remake is the $1.50 per splatted bag (kept as shipped, see PURE-CARNAGE-DECISIONS). nav says which guidance pieces show. kitchen: tipPerItem is a ticket's starting tip per item, decay is how fast it drains (cents/s), maxItems caps a ticket, every is the seconds between arrivals.
_extensions: Owner ruling 4: an extension is earned by EVERY 3 completed deliveries or tickets, wherever they came from. difficulty.md's 'all 3 bags from one load' is overruled.
